OSU Men's basketball head coach Jake Diebler found out that former OSU coach Thad Matta is retiring during his press conference this morning.  

Diebler worked for Matta when as a rising coach. 

Matta guided the Buckeyes to nine NCAA tournaments in 13 seasons. | Kellyanne Stitts | Facebook
